Each dialect’s `NewDB` in those entry files returns a `store.Driver`. `NewDBDriver` in `store/db/db.go` switches on `profile.Driver` (`sqlite` / `mysql` / `postgres`) and is called at startup from `cmd/memos/main.go`.
